plain_description.what: An engineering audit of every stored dual-order judging cache, row by row. It certifies whether each vote column records the screen position (left/right) or the named model, so that no statistic mixes the two.
plain_description.why: Position-bias and order analyses are wrong if they mix position-labelled and model-labelled votes.
plain_description.information: Result (no new calls): the certificate holds and was independently reproduced to the digit. No cache mixes frames. One cache could not be certified because of commit timing. One backup copy was misclassified because of its filename, an instrument artefact. It certifies frames only, not any bias number, and 11 caches are not backed up.
